scope: Current Nora Tavern architecture before World Core v2

scenarios.runtime_observation: Importing one source card has produced two Worlds with different chat bindings.
scenarios.target_outcome: Retries of one Import Operation return one World; an explicit second creation uses a new operation key.

scenarios.runtime_observation: A created World can be absent from the UI or lose its character and Worldbook projection after refresh.
scenarios.target_outcome: An authoritative World remains listed regardless of character-library and recent-chat loading order.

scenarios.runtime_observation: A valid imported card with no first message or alternate greeting produced a header-only chat and a blank scene.
scenarios.target_outcome: The World opens with an explicit empty-story state and remains a valid, visible World.

scenarios.runtime_observation: MVU readiness timeout was reported as World open failure; hiding the error did not prove MVU readiness.
scenarios.target_outcome: The base World opens and MVU reports READY or DEGRADED independently with a retry path.
